source_artifacts.description: Session summary describing the strategic shift toward a personal cognitive garden.

claim: The user wants LS to focus on personal, goal-directed cognitive gardens rather than a generic shared cognitive network.
evidence: The user described each person developing their own cognitive graph.
The user said connected agents and sessions should help cultivate that graph like a garden.
The user connected the idea to human development and commercial value.

development_effect.capital_effect: Increases the person's ability to turn vague product intuition into a structured, governable, and commercially legible development system.
development_effect.practice_needed: Convert the insight into a schema, examples, and one small MVP flow so the direction becomes an inspectable artifact rather than only a conversation.
assessment_notes: The session is developmental because it clarifies product direction and creates a reusable skill-capital framing.
The update should not be treated as durable identity or company-visible performance data without review.

policy_notes: This update affects long-term project/product direction and should remain proposed until the human accepts it.
No external action or employer-visible reporting is allowed from this proposal alone.
